summary: Barclays PLC filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing London Stock Exchange disclosures under the UK Market Abuse Regulation regarding transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities. The filing reports dividend reinvestments of the 2026 half-year dividend by PDMRs, including Group Finance Director Anna Cross (91 shares at 4.730) and Group Co-COO Craig Bright (10,354 shares at 4.725 and 93 shares at 4.730), all dated 22 September 2026. These are ordinary share plan and nominee service reinvestments, not open-market purchases. No special-situation terms, board recommendation, advisors, or regulatory clocks are present; no deal-risk arbitrage angle applies.
